title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: monitor agents (GCC, GCC High and DoD)
summary: Hold: the briefing reports an unknown arrival default even though Microsoft says the Risky Agents policy is automatically present for all organisations with supported licences after service setup. It also overstates alert access: being an unrestricted administrator does not by itself grant permission to investigate alerts.

claims.fix: The Before rollout role-group decision and After rollout Usage center check have no matching controls-table row. The disabling/scoping absence in Governance controls also has no matching absence row. This finding identifies the uncovered steps; it does not request additional rows.
